<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"query","name":"definitionTypes","required":false,"description":"List of automation types.    \nSupported values:\nSCRIPT_JSON: **Flow** automation created via API.  \nSCRIPT_TEXT: **Flow** automation created via the Aqara Studio Web page.  \nWHEN_IF_THEN: **Classic** automation.  \nLEGACY_FLOW: **Flow** automation (legacy version).  \nLEGACY_LINKAGE: **Logic** automation.  \nOTHER: Other automation types.    \nExample: definitionTypes=SCRIPT_JSON,LEGACY_FLOW or definitionTypes=SCRIPT_JSON&definitionTypes=LEGACY_FLOW.\nIf not provided or empty, all types will be queried.   \nconfig update qualification is not limited by this classification.\n","schema":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["SCRIPT_JSON","SCRIPT_TEXT","WHEN_IF_THEN","LEGACY_FLOW","LEGACY_LINKAGE","OTHER"]}}},{"in":"query","name":"automationName","required":false,"description":"Fuzzy match keyword for automation name; if not provided or empty, the name will not be filtered.","schema":{"type":"string"},"example":"Turn on the lights when coming home"},{"in":"query","name":"spaceIds","required":false,"description":"Whether to query automations under the specified list of space IDs.
